install.title: Put Ekonomi on your home screen
install.body: It then opens as an app, full screen and without the browser's address bar. It takes ten seconds.

welcome.title: Welcome to Finance
welcome.body: This is where you submit expenses, attest and follow the section's money. We'll quickly go over what is here. Each page then has a short guide of its own the first time you open it.

todo.title: Your turn
todo.body: Everything waiting on you is gathered here, whether it is an expense, an invoice or a card purchase. Whatever is late comes first. Click a row to go straight to it.

groupExpenses.title: Expenses
groupExpenses.body: Submit expenses and account for purchases made with the section's cards.

groupInvoices.title: Supplier invoices
groupInvoices.body: Invoices to the section, from the inbox until they are in Fortnox.

groupBookkeeping.title: Bookkeeping
groupBookkeeping.body: The section's income and the year-end close.

groupBudget.title: Budget & outcome
groupBudget.body: The budgets, and what has actually been booked.

groupStock.title: Stock
groupStock.body: The products, sales events and stock history.

groupRental.title: Rentals
groupRental.body: Rentals and the equipment that is rented out.

groupAdmin.title: Agreements
groupAdmin.body: The section's agreements and the parties to them.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Roles, cost centres, Fortnox and the rest of the app's settings.

year.title: Financial year
year.body: The year applies to every page at once. It narrows what is already finished, so last year's booked items are not mixed in with this year's.

help.title: FAQ
help.body: Unsure about a receipt or a rule? The answers are under FAQ.

theme.title: Theme
theme.body: Light or dark mode. The guides are here too, if you want to see them again.

language.title: Language
language.body: The app is available in Swedish and English.

intro.title: Expenses
intro.body: If you paid for something for the section, with your own money or a section card, you account for it here. Every expense goes through the same steps until it is booked.

new.title: New expense
new.body: Add an expense here. Take a photo of the receipt, say what it was for and pick a cost centre. Mileage for a car is in the same menu.

stages.title: Where is my expense?
stages.body: The tabs show where an expense is. Drafts are yours to submit or correct. Then To attest, where the person responsible approves, To book and To export with the treasury, and finally Exported.

scopeMine.title: Mine
scopeMine.body: What you submitted yourself. You can always see where your expenses are here.

scopeUnit.title: My result unit
scopeUnit.body: Expenses on the cost centres you answer for. Under To attest they are waiting on you. Open one to attest it or ask for changes.

scopeAll.title: All
scopeAll.body: The whole section's expenses. Book them under To book, and send them to Fortnox under To export with Review and post on the expense's page.

intro.title: Bank transactions
intro.body: Purchases from the section's account and cards. Every card purchase needs a receipt, just like an expense.

unaccounted.title: To account for
unaccounted.body: Card purchases still missing a receipt. Open one and turn it into an expense with the receipt. The sooner, the better your accounting score.

scopeMine.title: Mine
scopeMine.body: Purchases made with your own section card.

scopeUnit.title: My result unit
scopeUnit.body: Card purchases on your cost centres, so you can see what your unit has bought.

scopeAll.title: All
scopeAll.body: The whole bank feed, payments made without a card included.

import.title: Import
import.body: Read in bank statements here. The purchases are then matched to cards and expenses.

intro.title: Inbox
intro.body: Every supplier invoice starts here as a document, emailed or uploaded. It becomes an invoice once a result unit has allocated it.

unit.title: Your unit's documents
unit.body: Documents given to your unit land here. Open one, split the amount over your cost centres and attest it, and it moves on to Invoices.

sort.title: To sort
sort.body: New documents no unit has been given yet. Give each one to the unit it concerns.

units.title: With the units
units.body: Documents a unit has been given but not allocated yet. See what is waiting with whom.

upload.title: Upload
upload.body: Upload an invoice that came on paper or as a file. Invoices emailed to the inbox's address arrive here by themselves.

intro.title: Invoices
intro.body: Supplier invoices, from allocation until they are in Fortnox. Open a row to see the whole invoice and what has happened to it.

stages.title: The steps
stages.body: To attest with the unit, then To book and To send with the treasury, and finally In Fortnox.

scopeUnit.title: My result unit
scopeUnit.body: Invoices on your cost centres. Under To attest they are waiting on you.

scopeAll.title: All
scopeAll.body: The whole section's invoices. Book an invoice on its page and send it to Fortnox from there.

intro.title: Income
intro.body: The section's sales, one report per day. Reports are fetched, reviewed and booked, then sent to Fortnox.

actions.title: Fetch, review, export
actions.body: Fetch a period reads in new days. Review and book goes through them one at a time. Export all sends the booked ones to Fortnox.

stages.title: The steps
stages.body: To book is days nobody has reviewed yet. To export is booked but not sent. Exported is in Fortnox.

intro.title: Budget
intro.body: The section's budgets, one or more per year. Open a budget to see it in detail or as a frame per result unit.

compare.title: Compare
compare.body: Tick two or more budgets in the list and compare them side by side.

new.title: New budget
new.body: Create an empty budget, copy an existing one or read one in from CSV.

intro.title: Outcome & reports
intro.body: What has actually been booked in Fortnox, compared with the budget. The figures are fetched from Fortnox every night.

params.title: Pick a report
params.body: Choose the report, period and result unit here. The income statement shows income and costs, the balance sheet assets and liabilities.

tools.title: Table, chart and export
tools.body: Show the period as a table or a chart, and take the report away as a PDF or to Excel.

intro.title: Stock
intro.body: The section's products and how much there is of each. Open a product to see its history and change it.

sections.title: Stock pages
sections.body: Events are sales and occasions where stock was used. History shows every movement and statistics over time.

attention.title: Need a look
attention.body: Products where something does not add up: a balance below zero, a difference at the stocktake or a barcode that is wrong.

manage.title: Register
manage.body: Register a delivery or a stocktake for every product at once, or add a new product.
